scenes.title: 03:00 · MID-OCEAN
scenes.voiceover: At three a.m., an unfamiliar vibration breaks a ship's steady rhythm.

scenes.title: NVIDIA DGX SPARK
scenes.voiceover: With NVIDIA DGX Spark onboard, ShipMind brings powerful local AI to the watch—compact, responsive, and ready beyond the network.

scenes.title: FOUR STREAMS · ONE BRIEFING
scenes.voiceover: It unites acoustics, gauges, radar, sonar, and route movement into one clear, evidence-backed picture.

scenes.title: ASK: HOW ARE THINGS NOW?
scenes.line: Qwen3-4B-FP8 answers on DGX Spark in ~3s.
scenes.voiceover: The engineer asks, “How are things now?” In seconds, the local AI traces the change, cites the signals, and shows what to inspect next.

scenes.title: THE PLATFORM STACK
scenes.voiceover: Agent Skills, DeepStream, StepFun, Qwen, and vLLM turn Spark into a complete, reproducible workflow.
